description: A signed kill switch issued by Meridian's control plane to remotely disable trust for a compromised build. The signature is a REAL Ed25519 signature over the canonical preimage and verifies against the public key below; it is reproduced byte-for-byte by the Rust core (crypto::kill_switch_preimage) and the Go server (compliance.killSwitchPreimage). The signing key is derived from a fixed demo seed so this fixture is reproducible (see fixtures/README.md).
preimage_layout: u32_be(len)||DOMAIN || u32_be(len)||tenant_id || u32_be(len)||app_id || u32_be(len)||build_hash || u64_be(command) || u64_be(version) || u64_be(issued_at) || u32_be(len)||reason
notes: command=DISABLE kills trust for exactly this build_hash; ENABLE is the implicit default for every other build. version is monotonic per scope (anti-rollback): re-issuing the same scope bumps it. The switch is delivered inside the signed ConfigResponse (control/config-envelope.json) so the device verifies it offline against the pinned signing key; a flipped command or build_hash fails verification and is ignored (fail-safe).
